title: elytrigia repens subsp. lolioides
intro: Elytrigia repens subsp. lolioides, commonly known as creeping meadow-grass or quackgrass, is a perennial grass native to Eurasia and North Africa. It is a plant species known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Elytrigia repens subsp. lolioides include its ability to exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities, making it a promising candidate for the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
